adds, already in one shape so the HTTP layer does not need to know

refusal.description: Present on a refusal, naming which rule refused.

jurisdiction.description: Which body of law or practice it belongs to.

Computed server-side by diffing before against after — never supplied by the

fieldsAdded.description: Fields that were absent and are now present.

fieldsDeleted.description: Fields that were present and are now absent.

location.description:
Where in the source. The publisher's own addressing — "Section
16(2)(b)", a page, a clause — never ours, because ours would not
survive a reader going to check.

One member of a class. `instanceOf` is a local name or an absolute IRI, the
same as a property's domain — and a name no class in the model declares is
refused by `check_model`'s `instanceOfUndefined` rather than written as
`owl:Thing`.

disjoint.description:

successorFqn.description:

to be machine-readable so an agent can redirect rather than merely warn
— an agent that recommends a dead asset without saying so is the most
damaging failure this system can produce, because it is confidently

sunsetAt.description:
When it becomes `Retired`. Absent means "no date decided yet", which is
honest and common.

liveValue.description: The value currently in live state, if any.

What a reader sees. Resolved at read time from the principal's record, so
a renamed team shows its new name everywhere rather than whatever it was
called when ownership was assigned.

True when this owner was not recorded on the entity itself but found by
walking up the containment hierarchy.

kind.description: Whether it is a user or a team.

Why two entities were judged the same. Kept on the record rather than
only the final score, so a wrong merge is diagnosable — "these matched on
`SameParent` and a `0.61` name similarity" is checkable by a steward;
